control.title: Financial regulator incident reporting
control.description: Report cyber incidents to your financial sector regulator within its deadline (RBI through DAKSH or the PSO format, SEBI, IRDAI or IFSCA, usually within 6 hours of detection), send follow-up and root-cause reports when due, and keep proof of every submission.

evidence_hint: Incident records with regulator report timestamps, acknowledgements from the regulator portal or mailbox.
acceptance_criteria: Incident records show when each incident was detected and when the regulator was informed
Reports reached the regulator within its deadline (usually 6 hours), or the plan names the regulator, portal and owner
Follow-up or root-cause reports are on file where the regulator asks for them

criteria_coverage.criterion: Incident records show when each incident was detected and when the regulator was informed
Reports reached the regulator within its deadline (usually 6 hours), or the plan names the regulator, portal and owner
Follow-up or root-cause reports are on file where the regulator asks for them

requirements.title: Report security incidents and card data breaches to RBI
requirements.guidance: Report security incidents and card data breaches to RBI in the stipulated time, plus monthly cyber incident reports with root cause and preventive actions.

requirements.title: Report incidents to RBI within 6 hours
requirements.guidance: A Board-approved incident response mechanism with forensics; report incidents to RBI in the Annex 1 format within 6 hours of detection, and to CERT-In.
